test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following relationship chart, A→B means A is the mother (or any other relationship) of B. Now using the chart, select the option that can replace the question mark (?) in it, if all the mentioned individuals, 1, 2, 3 and 4 are males.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b5b48e2a35485cacea0893589468d096d312df7b3d486959768a1d76240ebd5.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A → (is to any relationship) with B
 
 

 Symbol
 1 → 2
 1 → 3
 1 → 4
 2 → 3
 4 → 3
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Brother
 Son
 Nephew
 ?
 
 

Given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54eacaeb541a9e2aeec81e8212232214dc406db4e4f7086d1aed91fa427340f0.png] 

So, 4 can be either father or mother of 3.

As out of all the options, father is given therefore, 4 is the father of 3.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
